problems.explain: 99.85 is exactly halfway between 99.8 and 99.9, so nothing about distance decides it. The convention is to go up, giving 99.9. It is a rule agreed on, not a fact discovered — which is why it has to be told.

problems.explain: 99.95 is exactly halfway between 99.9 and 100.0, so nothing about distance decides it. The convention is to go up, giving 100.0. It is a rule agreed on, not a fact discovered — which is why it has to be told. To 1 decimal place it is written 100.0, not 100: the last 0 says the number is right as far as that place.
